tortoise_adjust_relationship.description: Adjust an existing epistemic link. Dispatches on the ADJUSTMENT: reason=/strength=/credibility= → mitigate the edge (a graded dampener, strength 0.10-0.50); bias/precision/consistency/directness → annotate its four epistemic dimensions; action=mitigate|annotate keeps the legacy spelling. Annotating a link is `update_knowledge` on it — this verb is the one for STRENGTH. ⛔ The mitigation arm is idem

tortoise_approve_merge.description: Review a dedup/temporal candidate — action=merge|reject. Wiring deferred to promotion for live priors. WRITES review flags + wires edges. NOT idempotent for every branch: a repeat of a DEDUP review records its event again, so it is visible twice to poll_events (the temporal branch does guard one).

tortoise_calibrate_summary.description: Audit graph calibration state. Returns per-point guidance.

tortoise_check_confidence.description: How confident the graph is — the confidence view, its recompute, and its recall (#4282 row 5). Dispatch is by argument: claim_id = one claim's EP posterior {mean,variance,alpha,beta}, and include_provenance adds the chain behind it; topic = the dated belief chain for a topic; session = what happened last session, including its confidence changes; calibrate (or no selector) = the graph-wide calibra

tortoise_check_connection.description: What does this credential reach? (#4282 row 40 — programmatic, returns a result, NOT a wizard). Omit key_id: connectivity, the resolved graph + namespace, and this caller's own account. Pass key_id: one credential's declared reach (graph, scopes, delegation depth, revocation, expiry). Read-only. A key belonging to another account and a key that does not exist give the SAME answer, so this cannot b

tortoise_check_structure.description: Check Gate 0→4 chain integrity (orphans, dangling refs).

tortoise_create_entity.description: Create an entity — type: subject|object|event|document|point|diary. Event entities wire about* edges from aboutSubject/aboutObject/aboutPoint/aboutDocument props. Returns {node, nudges, advisories?} — nudges suggest IMPL/NAND/mitigate connections to related Points; advisories notes a write that declared no source and no provenance (advisory only, never a block). For type='document', declaring extr

tortoise_delete_knowledge.description: Delete one item by id — a Point, a relation (operators are Points), a Source, an Object, a Subject, or an Event. DESTRUCTIVE and PERMANENT: cannot be undone. The FIRST call changes nothing: it previews which node resolves and every edge that would go with it, and returns a confirmation token. Call again with confirmation=<token> to delete. When the item is wrong rather than unwanted, supersede it

tortoise_diary_read.description: Read recent diary entries for an agent, newest first.

tortoise_expand_relationships.description: Full relationship payload for ONE Point, incl. each related point's content (the expand side of the #1353 list/expand split — search returns bounded state entries; use this to read a neighbor's full text on demand).

tortoise_explore_connections.description: Walk outward from a node through its links (#4282 row 8). node_id = the entity-centric BFS from that node, neighbours categorised by layer; node_id + include_content = the full payload for one Point, every neighbour's text included; query = resolve a natural-language query to the node it names, then walk from it. hops bounds the walk (default 2).

tortoise_get_entity.description: Get any entity by ID, eventId, or url. `type` selects the node kind (point | entity | operator | event | session | events | governance), dispatching exactly as the retired per-type getters did; omit it to look the entity up by id. The canonical fetch-by-id tool.

tortoise_get_historical_knowledge.description: Point-in-time read: what was true at `at_date`. Walks the CORRECTS chain from `point_id` (a current or superseded Point) to the point whose [validFrom, validTo] window covers the date. EVERY reply carries `status` (found | ambiguous | absent) and `found`; branch on `status`, never on `found` alone — `ambiguous` carries `found: true` with two or more `candidates` and NO `valid_point`. A `found` rep

tortoise_graph_overview.description: What is in this memory graph and how it is shaped — ONE orientation call (#4282 row 6). section: taxonomy|structure|structure_check|pointkinds|tags|sources|namespaces|graphs|topics|health|status|stale (the consolidated list_*/status/health zoo); validate_domain (requires domain); audit (optional point_kinds); dream_health. Omit section → a compact combined summary in the same envelope this family

tortoise_graph_set_recording.description: Set or clear a graph's session-recording override (#2302) — the MCP twin of PATCH /v1/graphs/{graph_id} (recording), sharing the same hosted_api core so the surfaces never drift. recording: true/false sets the per-graph override, null removes it (inherit the team default — never flips a team ON). Requires hosted mode + a team:manage-scoped key (or legacy full-access) — the capture 409 ('Session re

tortoise_index_sources_from_directory.description: Register a directory's files as sources — NOTHING is extracted (#4282 row 15). The three older per-kind indexing doors redirect here: `file_type='agent_session'` files a session transcript and `file_type='doc'` a document corpus. `extract_metadata` defaults PER ARM to the absorbed door's own value (`true` for `agent_session` only) and `llm_model` is forwarded on the arms that had it. `file_type`:

tortoise_ingest.description: Heterogeneous bulk write (epic #888 W4) — one call writes points + entities + sources + connections coherently (nodes first, then connections). Connections carrying 'operator' (IMPL/NAND) create operator Points per the reification rule (v3.5 §8); connections carrying 'relation' stay plain structural edges. Local refs address bundle items. Endpoint typing (#7925): connections on BOTH routes — opera

tortoise_link_entities.description: Connect two nodes — the relation decides HOW. One linking verb for five writers: `wasDerivedFrom` → the derivation writer; `IMPL`/`NAND` without operator=true → a bare direct edge; `supports`/`refutes`/`mutuallySupportive`/`mutuallyExclusive` or operator=true → a carrying operator Point; `references` + entity_label → the provenance writer (the only arm with the sourceVersion anchor); anything else

tortoise_list_batches.description: Batch discovery — the most recent distinct ingest batch_ids with their point/direct-edge counts (ordered by newest stamp, capped at limit, default 20).

tortoise_list_knowledge.description: One list method; kind selects the collection (#4282 row 4). Browse and filter WITHOUT a text search. kind: claim (default) = Points by pointKind/property filters, paged over a total order with {results,total,hasMore}; source = every provenance Source with its point count; source_reliability = one Source's derived reliability (url required — recomputes and caches the derivation); batch = one bundle

tortoise_manage_source_trust.description: Set how far a source is trusted (#4282 row 18). Dispatch is BY ARGUMENT: `tier=` (T0-T4) sets the credibility tier; `score=` with `assessor=` and `rationale=` records an assessment (a reputation-weighted Statement Point). Passing both is refused — they are different writes. The one trust door — both former arms (set a tier, or record a scored assessment) live here. Reads: tortoise_graph_overview(s

tortoise_manage_sources.description: Configure the memory sources this team uses (the ones Tortoise reads FROM). action: list|enable|disable; source: github_issues|github_documents|agent_sessions. list returns EVERY source with its current state and its default, in one call. enable/disable act only within the caller's own permission for this team — a key without graphs:write is REFUSED, never self-granted — and no action accepts, ret

tortoise_mine_knowledge_from_directory.description: Mine a FOLDER of files, each by its own content type (#4282 row 17) — the batch form of tortoise_mine_knowledge_from_session, not a kind of indexing: this call EXTRACTS, tortoise_index_sources_from_directory does not. It absorbs the retired conversations-mining door. EXCLUDED from tenant HTTP — walks the server filesystem.

tortoise_mine_knowledge_from_session.description: Mine ONE session (#4282 row 16). Dispatch is BY ARGUMENT: `conversation=` files an agent session (turns become episodic Points, LLM extraction produces epistemic Points; the backend is the target graph's configuration) — same door and gates as the retired session-capture shim, whose `machine_id=`/`model=` attribution claims are forwarded too; `conversation=` as a raw transcript STRING (with `sourc

tortoise_org_create.description: Create isolated team graph via FalkorDB select_graph. EXCLUDED from tenant HTTP — provisioning belongs to /internal/provision behind FASTAPI_INTERNAL_KEY.

tortoise_poll_events.description: Poll graph/claim events after an opaque cursor (at-least-once). Returns {events, next_cursor}. Event types: 12 registered claim types (PointAdded, OperatorAdded, PointRetracted, PointSuperseded, OperatorAnnotated, PointPromoted, OperatorPromoted, DedupeRecorded, DedupeRejected, ObjectSuperseded, PointInvalidated, PointRevised). PointRevised reaches the store, and the response adds `changes` (per-c

tortoise_query.description: Query points by pointKind and/or property filters — structural exact-match retrieval for known shapes (Epic #888: paginated_query + query_points_by_tag merged in). BOTH the structural read and the `tag=` arm return at most `limit` rows — default 100, or 20 when you page (`offset=`/`page=`) without an explicit `limit`. The RESPONSE is what is bounded (and a truncated answer is not distinguishable f

tortoise_record_decision.description: Record that a question was resolved — a human approval of a planning artifact: an Event (eventKind humanApproval) with full provenance, a decision Point carrying an EP evidence prior, and unidirectional IMPL (approvedBy) edges to the approved claims so dependent claims strengthen. Returns {event_id, decision_point_id, impl_operator_ids, confidence_delta}.

tortoise_refresh_confidence.description: Recompute or seed a belief's confidence. Dispatches on SCOPE: scope='dirty' (default) → dream the accumulated dirty subgraph; scope='full' → whole-graph stabilization; scope='promote' → the reviewer-gated draft→live promotion of point_id; scope='baseline' → set point_id's Beta prior (alpha, beta). The two scopes are stated as a parameter, never chosen silently.

tortoise_register_source.description: Declare a source exists — the URL is its identity (#4282 row 14). The one declaring door: the retired per-kind entry points redirect here. `tier` (T0-T4) overrides the tier the source KIND derives; `sourceDate` is the evidence-age clock. An existing Source (URL collision) is never re-kinded.

tortoise_review_link_candidates.description: Connections found but not made — READ-ONLY (#4282 row 10). kind: connections (default) = related-but-missing suggestions and illogical/stale links, mode=add|prune|both with an optional scope; dedup = the deduplication review queue (candidate_type=content|entity); cross_lens = unverified cross-source candidate pairs. Nothing here writes: accept a candidate by calling link_entities with its two endp

tortoise_search.description: Hybrid semantic search — FTS + vector + structural RRF fusion with EP confidence annotation. Use when matching by MEANING (natural-language query); for exact structural/filter queries use tortoise_query. Full-scan mode: omit query, set kind → all Points of kind.

tortoise_search_knowledge.description: Find things by text — ONE search door (#4282 row 3). mode selects which question: hybrid (default) = meaning-ranked RRF fusion of full-text + vector + structural, EP-annotated (omit query and set kind to enumerate a kind); full_text = exact pointKind/property matching with NO ranking, paged over a total order and returning {results,total,hasMore}; tag = the Points reachable through one Tag (page s

tortoise_search_sessions.description: Search indexed agent sessions. Returns Events with narrative_arc snippets.

tortoise_suggest_entry_points.description: Entity resolution — NL query → matching entities from the graph.

tortoise_supersede_knowledge.description: Replace a node with a successor, keeping the history. The arm follows the OLD node's label: a Point gets a full supersede — CORRECTS edge, outdated flag, and every edge moved from old to new; an Object/Subject gets the family supersede — status='superseded' + supersededBy (the successor's NAME) + supersededAt, no edge transfer. transfer_edges=None (default, not supplied) takes that label-driven ar

tortoise_update_knowledge.description: Change what a stored thing says — ONE revise verb for a Point, an entity or an epistemic link — or retract it. Dispatches on WHICH FIELDS are set: props → a property update (point-lifecycle for a Point, plain properties for an entity); annotation={bias,precision,consistency,directness} → annotate the link; invalid_at=/valid_until= (+ corrected_by_id=) → retract, or invalidate against a successor.

tortoise_write_question.description: File a QUESTION with its options and the evidence behind them — not a decision. Creates the question, its option Points, the evidence Points and the IMPL edges atomically. options: option descriptions; evidence: evidence statements; choice: 0-indexed preferred option. Returns {decision_id, option_ids, evidence_ids}.
